promptSummary: Read PROJECT.md and chat/result-renderer implementation, answer in Chinese with concise conclusions, bullets for final answer/process expansion/tool preview/right canvas/verification, no table, no raw local paths or logs.

visualStates.collapsed: Completed process groups render as lightweight Worked/Explored rows without replay headers or SciForge summary cards.
visualStates.expanded: Expanded process content sits in the same chat page flow: file/search leaf rows have no visible completion timestamp, More activity is muted, and final audit labels are hidden.

alignmentChecks: same complex prompt was used as the comparison prompt
completed read/search rows default to compact Cursor-like group rows
expanded rows avoid Details, Preview file, Stdout, Stderr, raw artifact/file prefixes, and log-block prose
trusted file action remains row-clickable while right-pane content stays separate from the chat answer
active assistant draft normalization removes redacted path placeholders and repaired split technical identifiers
observations: Browser retest found no visible Stdout/Stderr labels, no raw artifact/file prefixes in action refs, and no final audit Detail/Supporting detail text.
Leaf action completion usage and action timestamps compute to display:none, matching Cursor's plain Read/Search rows.
SciForge still preserves failures and running state when they are meaningful, but completed leaf rows do not carry status chrome.
limitations: The current SciForge live run included failed read rows from backend path handling; this evidence focuses on presentation shape and redaction rather than answer correctness.
Sub-agent positive parity remains governed by the existing open difference and is not claimed by this round.

redaction.notes: Summary is refs-first and excludes raw DOM, raw accessibility tree, full transcript, provider details, secrets, and local absolute paths.
